Every price here is read from that pool's own slot0 this second, and the mid above is weighted by each venue's depth within ±2% — not by TVL. The $775k full-range pool holds four times the capital of the 1% pool and contributes a fifth as much tradeable depth, because full-range liquidity is spread from zero to infinity. A pool quoting far from the mid has not been arbitraged yet; that gap is real, and an aggregator reporting one blended price hides it.
